title: SkyRiver
description:
This mod adds features to the Rede Canary's SkyBlock (redecanary.fun).

Features:
/skyriver status: Health & mana bars
/skyriver alert: Alerts when mentioned chat
/skyriver corvip <color>: Set color in global chat
/skyriver help: Shows commands
body:
## **Features**:

- **/skyriver status**: Barras de vida e mana
- **/skyriver alerta**: Alerta quando o jogador for mencionado no chat
- **/skyriver corvip <cor>**: Definir cor da mensagem no global (/g)
- **/skyriver ajuda**: Mostra os comandos do mod

_English_
- **/skyriver status**: Health and mana bars
- **/skyriver alert**: Alerts when the player is mentioned in chat
- **/skyriver corvip <color>**: Set message color in global chat (/g)
- **/skyriver help**: Shows mod commands
